name: knowtorious
description: Project knowledge on demand: a session-start table of contents plus list, get and search MCP tools over a .knowtorious/ vault.

interface.longDescription: Loads a table of contents of the project's .knowtorious/ vault at session start (entry ids and titles, never content) and serves list, get and search over MCP, so the agent fetches only the entries a task needs. Requires the kt binary on your PATH; without kt or a vault it does nothing.
